_readme: All chatbot copy and routing lives here. Edit 'messages' and 'buttons' freely. Each button's 'next' must match a node name below. Message formatting: **bold**, a line break with \n, and links as [link text](https://url "utm_content-value"). UTM source/medium/campaign are added automatically from settings.utm.
